name: douc
about: A red-shanked douc (voọc chà vá chân nâu, Pygathrix nemaeus), a male: about 62 cm long without the tail, a white tail as long as the body, a silver-grey coat, black thighs, red lower legs, black hands and feet, a yellow-brown face with white cheeks. It walks on four limbs.
sources: Wikipedia, Red-shanked douc (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Red-shanked_douc): "The male has a head and body length of 55–82 centimetres" and "a tail that measures 56–74 centimetres"; "Their abdomen and back are silver"; "Their face is a yellow-brown color"; "Their inner arms and inner, lateral and back thighs are black while their lower legs are a vibrant red." "Both feet and hands are black"; "Their tails are white".

The regions of the coat paint the lower legs and the hands in one color (socks): the hands are red, not black, and the forearms are not white. The numbers of the shape: a guess from photos of iNaturalist.
The lengths of the fur (fur): a guess from photos of the animal, not a measurement.
